strengths: Geometry, physical 8 mm glazing, candle source, and inverse-square practical light transfer as one placed renderer-independent asset.
Iron frame, bracket load path, candle flame, glass, and restrained local wall pool remain readable in cool and warm environments.
The same fixture definition follows model placement without duplicated world-space lights.
Final witnesses retain 0% clipped whites while façade and warehouse black coverage remain within the unchanged 72% contract.
limitations: Accepted for background and medium-distance set dressing, not hero close-up product inspection.
The project-owned procedural iron and glazing lack the micro-scratches, fasteners, soot, and handcrafted asymmetry required for a close hero prop.
The candle is static; animated flame shape and photometric flicker remain a separate secondary-motion capability.
notes: Geometry v1 was rejected for an oversized clipped source, v2 for repeated white-disc reflections, and v3 for exposing an 85 mm emitter-radius semantic error. Geometry v4 corrects the source radius to 6 mm. Its first evidence set was subsequently rejected by fail-closed acceptance because whole-frame black coverage exceeded the declared limit; v5 improves only witness illumination and passes that unchanged gate.
